title: Purple Mage Fighter
description: A young female warrior with white hair in buns stands in a dynamic combat pose against a solid gray background. She wears white and purple traditional East Asian-inspired armor with a laced vest, wide pants, and sandals, holding a swirling purple energy ring in her right hand while casting a larger glowing purple magical orb with her left.
